title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.

title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.

title: Khuddar
desc: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.

title: Bhrashtachar
desc: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker; however, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies.
